# Combobox — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for a combobox when the answer is one of many known values and typing is quicker than scrolling: an assignee, a tag, a country, a template. It shows the current choice and offers the rest on demand, and the input filters as you type — so it is a select you can search and an autocomplete you can also browse. It is the wrong tool when the answer is free text, which is an input, or when the set is short enough to read, which is a radio group. Clear is its own control, because getting out of a wrong choice matters as much as getting in.

### Anatomy

| Part | Role |
| --- | --- |
| ComboboxRoot | Owns the query and the chosen value. Generic over the value type. |
| ComboboxLabel | Names the field. |
| ComboboxInput | Shows the choice and takes the query. |
| ComboboxTrigger | Opens the list without typing, for anyone who would rather browse. |
| ComboboxClear | Empties the field. Its own control, because undoing a wrong choice should not require selecting a right one. |
| ComboboxContent | The list surface. Portals to the end of the document and positions itself against the input. |
| ComboboxItem | One option. |
| ComboboxEmpty | What to show when the query matches nothing. |
| Combobox | The namespace object: all of the parts above. |

### Deviations from Material 3

**K6** — spec: M3's component elevation table names no combobox. It tabulates "menu" at level 2 and search at level 3; neither describes a typeahead selection field.

Kern: The combobox popup rests at elevation level 2.

Why: The open list behaves as an overlay above the page and needs the lift the other anchored overlays have. Borrowing the menu row would assert M3 described this surface, which it does not. Registered as K6 in the elevation inventory so the level is a recorded decision.

## Native

### Features

Reach for a combobox when the answer is one of many known values and typing is quicker than scrolling. The trigger is a read-only field display; the popup holds the filter field and the option list, so one editable field is on screen at a time. Typing narrows the full list, committing reports and closes, and dismissing drops the transient query. It is the wrong tool when the answer is free text (an input) or the set is short enough to read (a radio group or select).

### Usage

**Do**

- Declare options as `{ value, label }[]` — the trigger shows the chosen label, the popup shows the list.
- Keep the default substring filter unless matching is server-side or fuzzy; the default is the honest local behaviour.
- Drive `value`/`onValueChange` when the choice feeds state elsewhere; let it hold its own otherwise.

**Don't**

- Don't use it for free text — a query with no option to commit is an input.
- Don't duplicate the popup's filter field outside it — one editable field on screen at a time.

### Tokens

| Element | State | Token | Value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Field trigger | resting | theme.color.surface | surface, outline border, minHeight 56 |
| Popup | resting | theme.color.surfaceContainer | surfaceContainer, medium corners, level 2 (3dp) |
| Selected option | selected | theme.color.surfaceTonal | surfaceTonal wash behind the chosen row |

### Deviations from Material 3

**K6** — spec: M3's component elevation table names no combobox. It tabulates menus at level 2 — neither row describes a type-to-filter popup.

Kern: The combobox popup rests at elevation level 2.

Why: The open list floats above the page and needs the same lift the other anchored overlays have. The native popup renders `3dp`, which is M3 level 2 — the same resting height as the web popup.

### FAQ

**Combobox, select, or autocomplete?**

Type-to-narrow plus browse means combobox. A fixed set with no typing means select. The web autocomplete is a different surface; natively the combobox covers both jobs.

**How does this differ from the web combobox?**

Same contract (filter narrows, commit reports value plus option, dismiss drops the query). Web is multipart over Base UI with the input as the trigger; native is one flat component with the filter field inside the popup — the `Select`/`SegmentedButton` data convention.
